note: CLEFS ONLY. Every one of these cells is the first measure of a staff, so each prints a clef at its left edge. Box the clef glyph and nothing else. Pick the slot by WHICH CLEF IS DRAWN, not by which line it sits on — clefC covers alto/tenor/soprano and the line is read geometrically downstream. If a cell somehow shows no clef, Tab past it; that still records the sweep. These 24 cells are gathered from eight batches into one place; a merge script writes the boxes back to the batch each came from (origin.json). DSv2 also has clefCAlto/clefCTenor, but plain clefC is what v1-v4 used (8 boxes) and the line is measured downstream by clef_geometry, so stay on clefC. The little 8 under a treble clef is its OWN class (clef8) — box it separately if the print has one.
